criteria.description: FR-001 One read entry point per topology: every status read to resolve through one entry point that returns a declared source so that every command reports the same WP states. The source is: the write checkout for `single_branch`, `lanes` and provisional Missions; the coordination branch for `coord` / `lanes_with_coord` (its worktree file when materialized, the committed branch otherwise); and the repository root checkout of the target once consolidated.
criteria.proof_type: inspection: cited tests confirmed present on the approving lane branch via git show; WP approved in the cited review cycle; tests not re-run by this verifier

criteria.description: FR-002 Root normalised at every entry; never a lane root or missing path: every root-taking status entry point to re-anchor a lane root to the repository root (finishing #6884), and never return a lane directory or a path that does not exist, so that a lane copy is never read as truth.
criteria.proof_type: inspection: cited tests confirmed present on the approving lane branch via git show; WP approved in the cited review cycle; tests not re-run by this verifier

criteria.description: FR-003 Absent or empty coordination worktree reads the branch: a Mission whose coordination branch exists but whose worktree is absent or empty to read the committed branch, so that status survives short-lived checkouts. When the branch holds no log yet, the read falls back to the write checkout under a declared rule. Owned checkouts follow the same rule instead of raising.
criteria.proof_type: inspection: cited tests confirmed present on the approving lane branch via git show; WP approved in the cited review cycle; tests not re-run by this verifier

criteria.description: FR-004 Bad ref is not an absent file: the branch reader to raise a typed error for a missing or unreadable ref and to return an empty history only for an absent file on a readable ref, so that a broken ref never reads as genesis.
criteria.proof_type: inspection: cited tests confirmed present on the approving lane branch via git show; WP approved in the cited review cycle; tests not re-run by this verifier

criteria.description: FR-005 Every reader on the entry point: every status reader in the CLI on the one entry point, with the retired names removed, so that no adapter can drift. That covers the direct resolver calls, the placement status-state reads and the command-local helpers.
criteria.notes: Deferred by operator ruling; see reason.
criteria.deferral_reason: Partly delivered: consolidation readers moved onto the read door (WP07: done_bookkeeping x2, forecast, phase_advance, preflight; WP06 CLI/runtime readers). The remaining ~53 legacy status-read sites (~35 files) and retired-name removal are deferred to a follow-up Mission by operator ruling DM 01M6S40GBWB6JD0FFTMQ2F6NW7 (traces/design-decisions.md [implement WP07]).
criteria.deferral_follow_up: DM 01M6S40GBWB6JD0FFTMQ2F6NW7 (follow-up issue for the S1 single-door gate/migration not yet filed)

criteria.description: FR-006 Empty-allowlist call-site gate: an architectural gate that fails on any status read outside the entry point, so that the contract cannot erode. It must catch a direct call, an aliased import, an attribute call, an aliased status kind and a hand-joined events path. It has an empty allowlist, a scanned-file floor, a caller floor and planted-violation self-tests, and it amends (not bypasses) the existing gates that bless the old body.
criteria.notes: Deferred by operator ruling; see reason.
criteria.deferral_reason: Empty-allowlist single-door call-site gate deferred to a follow-up Mission by operator ruling DM 01M6S40GBWB6JD0FFTMQ2F6NW7; WP07 adds no gate and no allowlist (traces/design-decisions.md [implement WP07]).
criteria.deferral_follow_up: DM 01M6S40GBWB6JD0FFTMQ2F6NW7 (follow-up issue for the S1 single-door gate not yet filed)

criteria.description: FR-007 Read-contract ADR: an ADR or amendment that records the contract and explicitly reverses `coord-artifact-single-home-01M3V4BE#FR-017` and `coord-artifact-single-home-01M3V4BE#C-002` (the loud repository-root fallback for an empty coordination surface), so that the behaviour change is governed.
criteria.proof_type: inspection: cited ADR/doc sections confirmed present via git show/grep; WP approved in the cited review cycle
criteria.evidence: Document present on issue-7276-lane-worktree-hardening (planning lane): docs/adr/4.x/2026-11-06-2-one-status-read-contract.md (reverses coord-artifact-single-home-01M3V4BE#FR-017 and #C-002, lines ~164-166); docs/adr/3.x/2026-06-19-1-coord-empty-surface-fallback.md 'Amendment 2026-11-06: superseded by the one status read contract'; approved: kitty-specs/lane-worktree-model-hardening-01M6QY1M/tasks/WP01-adr-status-read-contract/review-cycle-1.md

criteria.description: FR-010 Count commits on the lane branch: the shared for_review gate to count commits on `refs/heads/<lane>` beyond its base from the repository root, so that the verdict never depends on a checkout.
criteria.proof_type: inspection: cited tests confirmed present on the approving lane branch via git show; WP approved in the cited review cycle; tests not re-run by this verifier

criteria.description: FR-011 Pass with the lane checkout absent: the gate to pass with the lane checkout absent when the lane branch carries a commit beyond its base, so that I never need `--force`.
criteria.proof_type: inspection: cited tests confirmed present on the approving lane branch via git show; WP approved in the cited review cycle; tests not re-run by this verifier

criteria.description: FR-012 Distinct refusal for a missing branch: a missing lane branch ref to refuse with its own reason naming the branch, so that it is never confused with "no commits" and never passes vacuously.
criteria.proof_type: inspection: cited tests confirmed present on the approving lane branch via git show; WP approved in the cited review cycle; tests not re-run by this verifier

criteria.description: FR-013 Surface parity: `agent status emit`, `orchestrator-api transition` and `move-task` to give the same verdict for the same lane state with the checkout absent, so that no surface is a workaround for another.
criteria.proof_type: inspection: cited tests confirmed present on the approving lane branch via git show; WP approved in the cited review cycle; tests not re-run by this verifier
